verses.en: Verily, thus saith the Lord unto you my servant Joseph, that inasmuch as you have inquired of my hand to know and understand wherein I, the Lord, justified my servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, as also Moses, David and Solomon, my servants, as touching the principle and doctrine of their having many wives and concubines—
verses.sm: E moni, ua faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii ia te oe la’u auauna, Iosefa, talu ai ona ua e ole mai i lo’u lima ia e iloa ma malamalama pe na faapefea ona ta’uamiotonuina e A’u, o le Alii, a’u auauna o Aperaamo, Isaako, ma Iakopo, e pei foi o a’u auauna o Mose, Tavita ma Solomona, e faatatau i le mataupu autu ma le mataupu faavae o lo latou faia o avā ma palake e toatele—

verses.en: Behold, and lo, I am the Lord thy God, and will answer thee as touching this matter.
verses.sm: Faauta, ma tagai, o A’u o le Alii lou Atua, ma o le a ou tali atu ia te oe e uiga i lenei mataupu.

verses.en: Therefore, prepare thy heart to receive and obey the instructions which I am about to give unto you; for all those who have this law revealed unto them must obey the same.
verses.sm: O lea, ia saunia lou loto e talia ma usiusitai i faatonuga o le a Ou tuu atu ia te oe; ona o i latou uma o e e faaali atu ia te i latou lenei tulafono e ao ina usiusitai i lea lava.

verses.en: For behold, I reveal unto you a new and an everlasting covenant; and if ye abide not that covenant, then are ye damned; for no one can reject this covenant and be permitted to enter into my glory.
verses.sm: Aua faauta, Ou te faaali atu ia te outou se feagaiga fou ma tumau e faavavau; afai tou te lē ola ai i lena feagaiga, ona tausalaina lea o outou; aua e leai se tasi e mafai ona teena lenei feagaiga ma faatagaina e ulu mai i lo’u mamalu.

verses.en: For all who will have a blessing at my hands shall abide the law which was appointed for that blessing, and the conditions thereof, as were instituted from before the foundation of the world.
verses.sm: Aua o i latou uma o e e fia mauaina se faamanuiaga i lo’u lima ia ola ai i le tulafono na tofia mo lena faamanuiaga, ma ona tulaga, e pei ona sa faatutuina mai a o le i faavaeina le lalolagi.

verses.en: And as pertaining to the new and everlasting covenant, it was instituted for the fulness of my glory; and he that receiveth a fulness thereof must and shall abide the law, or he shall be damned, saith the Lord God.
verses.sm: Ma e faatatau i le feagaiga fou ma tumau e faavavau, sa faatuina mo le atoatoaga o lo’u mamalu; ma o ia o lē e mauaina lona atoatoaga e ao ma tatau ona ola ai i le tulafono, po o le a tausalaina o ia, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii le Atua.

verses.en: And verily I say unto you, that the conditions of this law are these: All covenants, contracts, bonds, obligations, oaths, vows, performances, connections, associations, or expectations, that are not made and entered into and sealed by the Holy Spirit of promise, of him who is anointed, both as well for time and for all eternity, and that too most holy, by revelation and commandment through the medium of mine anointed, whom I have appointed on the earth to hold this power (and I have appointed unto my servant Joseph to hold this power in the last days, and there is never but one on the earth at a time on whom this power and the keys of this priesthood are conferred), are of no efficacy, virtue, or force in and after the resurrection from the dead; for all contracts that are not made unto this end have an end when men are dead.
verses.sm: Ma e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, o tuutuuga o lenei tulafono e faapea: O feagaiga, maliega, ioega, tautinoga, tautoga, folafolaga, tu, sootaga, mafutaga, po o faamoemoega uma, e lē faia ma osia ma faamauina i le Agaga Paia o le folafolaga, e ia o lē ua faauuina, mo le taimi nei ma mo le faavavau atoa, ma lena foi ua sili ona paia, i le faaaliga ma le poloaiga e ala i lē ua ou faauuina, o lē ua Ou tofia i le lalolagi e umia lenei mana (ma ua Ou tofia i la’u auauna o Iosefa e umia lenei mana i aso e gata ai, ma e lē sili atu lava i le toatasi lē e i le lalolagi e faaee atu i ai lenei mana ma ki o le perisitua i le taimi e tasi), e leai se aoga, āuga, po o se malosi i le toetutu mai ma pe a mavae le toetutu mai le oti; ona o maliega uma e lē faia mo lenei faamoemoe e i ai se iuga pe a oti tagata.

verses.en: Behold, mine house is a house of order, saith the Lord God, and not a house of confusion.
verses.sm: Faauta, o lo’u fale o se fale o le maopoopo, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii le Atua, ae lē o se fale o le fenumia’i.

verses.en: Will I accept of an offering, saith the Lord, that is not made in my name?
verses.sm: Ou te talia ea se taulaga, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii, ua lē faia i lo’u igoa?

verses.en: Or will I receive at your hands that which I have not appointed?
verses.sm: Pe Ou te talia mai i o outou lima se mea Ou te lei tofiaina?

verses.en: And will I appoint unto you, saith the Lord, except it be by law, even as I and my Father ordained unto you, before the world was?
verses.sm: Ma Ou te tofi atu ea ia te outou se mea, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii, vagana ai ua ala atu i se tulafono, e pei lava ona faauu atu e A’u ma lo’u Tamā ia te outou, a’o lei i ai le lalolagi?

verses.en: I am the Lord thy God; and I give unto you this commandment—that no man shall come unto the Father but by me or by my word, which is my law, saith the Lord.
verses.sm: O A’u o le Alii lou Atua; ma Ou te tuu atu ia te outou le poloaiga lenei— e leai se tagata e sau i le Tamā vagana e ala atu ia te a’u po o i la’u upu, o la’u tulafono lea, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii.

verses.en: And everything that is in the world, whether it be ordained of men, by thrones, or principalities, or powers, or things of name, whatsoever they may be, that are not by me or by my word, saith the Lord, shall be thrown down, and shall not remain after men are dead, neither in nor after the resurrection, saith the Lord your God.
verses.sm: Ma o mea uma o i le lalolagi, pe na faauuina e tagata, i nofoalii, po o itumalo, po o mana, po o mea ta’uta’ua, po o a lava na mea, ua lē ala atu ia te a’u po o i la’u upu, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii, o le a lafo i lalo, ma o le a lē tumau pe a mavae ona oti o tagata, pe i le toetutu mai po o le mavae o le toetutu mai, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii lou Atua.

verses.en: For whatsoever things remain are by me; and whatsoever things are not by me shall be shaken and destroyed.
verses.sm: Aua soo se mea e tumau e ala atu ia te a’u; ma o soo se mea e lē ala atu ia te a’u o le a luluina ma faaumatia.

verses.en: Therefore, if a man marry him a wife in the world, and he marry her not by me nor by my word, and he covenant with her so long as he is in the world and she with him, their covenant and marriage are not of force when they are dead, and when they are out of the world; therefore, they are not bound by any law when they are out of the world.
verses.sm: O lea, afai e faaipoipo e se tane se avā ia te ia i le lalolagi, ma lē faaipoipoina e ia o ia e a’u po o i la’u upu, ma osifeagaiga o ia ma ia a’o i ai pea o ia i le lalolagi ma ia foi faatasi ma ia, e lē aoga la laua feagaiga ma le faaipoipoga pe a oti i laua, ma pe a o ese i laua mai le lalolagi; o lea, e lē noatia i laua i se tulafono pe a o ese i laua mai le lalolagi.

verses.en: Therefore, when they are out of the world they neither marry nor are given in marriage; but are appointed angels in heaven, which angels are ministering servants, to minister for those who are worthy of a far more, and an exceeding, and an eternal weight of glory.
verses.sm: O lea, pe a o ese i laua mai le lalolagi, e lē faaipoipo i laua pe tuuina atu i le faaipoipoga; ae o ni agelu tofia i le lagi, o agelu ia o ni auauna galulue, e auauna atu ia te i latou o e ua agavaa mo se fuataga mamao tele atu, ma silisli atu na’uā, ma faavavau, o le mamalu.

verses.en: For these angels did not abide my law; therefore, they cannot be enlarged, but remain separately and singly, without exaltation, in their saved condition, to all eternity; and from henceforth are not gods, but are angels of God forever and ever.
verses.sm: Ona o nei agelu sa lē ola i la’u tulafono; o lea, e lē mafai ai ona faateleina i latou, ae tumau eseese ma nonofo taitoatasi, e aunoa ma le faaeaga, i lo latou tulaga faaolaina, i le faavavau atoa; ma e mai le taimi lena ma le agai i luma, e lē o ni atua, ae o ni agelu a le Atua e faavavau ma faavavau lava.

verses.en: And again, verily I say unto you, if a man marry a wife, and make a covenant with her for time and for all eternity, if that covenant is not by me or by my word, which is my law, and is not sealed by the Holy Spirit of promise, through him whom I have anointed and appointed unto this power, then it is not valid neither of force when they are out of the world, because they are not joined by me, saith the Lord, neither by my word; when they are out of the world it cannot be received there, because the angels and the gods are appointed there, by whom they cannot pass; they cannot, therefore, inherit my glory; for my house is a house of order, saith the Lord God.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, afai e faaipoipo e se tane se avā, ma osia se feagaiga ma ia mo le taimi nei ma mo le faavavau, afai e lē faia lena feagaiga e a’u po o i la’u upu, o la’u tulafono lea, ma lē faamauina e le Agaga Paia o le folafolaga, e ala atu ia te ia o lē ua Ou faauuina ma tofia i lenei mana, e lē aoga pe taulia pe a o ese i laua mai le lalolagi, ona ua lē faatasia i laua e a’u, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii, pe i la’u upu; a o ese i laua mai le lalolagi e lē mafai ona talia iina, ona ua tofia agelu ma atua iina, o e e lē mafai ona laua pasia; o lea, e lē mafai ona laua maua lo’u mamalu; aua o lo’u fale o se fale o le maopoopo, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii le Atua.

verses.en: And again, verily I say unto you, if a man marry a wife by my word, which is my law, and by the new and everlasting covenant, and it is sealed unto them by the Holy Spirit of promise, by him who is anointed, unto whom I have appointed this power and the keys of this priesthood; and it shall be said unto them—Ye shall come forth in the first resurrection; and if it be after the first resurrection, in the next resurrection; and shall inherit thrones, kingdoms, principalities, and powers, dominions, all heights and depths—then shall it be written in the Lamb's Book of Life, that he shall commit no murder whereby to shed innocent blood, and if ye abide in my covenant, and commit no murder whereby to shed innocent blood, it shall be done unto them in all things whatsoever my servant hath put upon them, in time, and through all eternity; and shall be of full force when they are out of the world; and they shall pass by the angels, and the gods, which are set there, to their exaltation and glory in all things, as hath been sealed upon their heads, which glory shall be a fulness and a continuation of the seeds forever and ever.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, afai e faaipoipo se tane i se avā i la’u upu, o la’u tulafono lea, ma i le feagaiga fou ma le tumau e faavavau, ma ua faamauina ia te i laua e le Agaga Paia o le folafolaga, e ia o lē ua faauuina, o lē ua Ou tofia i ai lenei mana ma ki o lenei perisitua; ma o le a fai atu ia te i laua— O le a oulua tutulai mai i le uluai toetutu; ma afai pe a mavae le uluai toetutu, i le toetutu mai e sosoo ai; ma o le a mautofi i nofoalii, malo, itumalo, ma mana, ma puleaga, o mea maualuluga uma ma loloto— ona tusia lea i le Tusi o le Ola a le Tamai Mamoe, e faapea o le a lē faia e ia se fasioti tagata e faamasaa ai le toto lē sala, ma afai e ola i laua i la’u feagaiga, ma lē faia se fasioti tagata e faamasaa ai le toto lē sala, o le a faia ia te i laua i mea uma i soo se mea e tuu atu e la’u auauna i luga o i laua, i le taimi nei, ma i le faavavau atoa; ma o le a taulia atoatoa pe a i ai i laua i fafo o le lalolagi; ma o le a laua pasi atu i agelu ma atua, o e ua faatutu iina, i lo laua faaeaga ma mamalu i mea uma, e pei ona faamauina i luga o o laua ulu, o le mamalu lea o le atoatoaga ma le faaauauina o fanau e faavavau ma faavavau lava.

verses.en: Then shall they be gods, because they have no end; therefore shall they be from everlasting to everlasting, because they continue; then shall they be above all, because all things are subject unto them. Then shall they be gods, because they have all power, and the angels are subject unto them.
verses.sm: Ona avea ai lea o i laua ma atua, aua ua leai so laua gataaga; o lea o le a i ai i laua mai le faavavau-tumau i le faavavau-tumau, ona ua i ai pea lava i laua; ona avea ai lea o i laua i luga o mea uma, aua ua pule i laua i mea uma. Ona avea ai lea o i laua ma atua, aua ua ia i laua le mana uma, ma o agelu e i lalo o la laua puleaga.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, except ye abide my law ye cannot attain to this glory.
verses.sm: E moni, e moni, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, vagana ua outou ola i la’u tulafono e lē mafai ona outou maua lenei mamalu.

verses.en: For strait is the gate, and narrow the way that leadeth unto the exaltation and continuation of the lives, and few there be that find it, because ye receive me not in the world neither do ye know me.
verses.sm: Aua e vaapiapi le faitotoa, ma lauitiiti le ala e tau i le faaeaga ma le faaauauga o ola, ma e toaitiiti e e i ai e mauaina, ona ua outou lē talia a’u i le lalolagi pe tou te iloa a’u.

verses.en: But if ye receive me in the world, then shall ye know me, and shall receive your exaltation; that where I am ye shall be also.
verses.sm: Ae afai tou te talia a’u i le lalolagi, ona outou iloa lea o a’u, ma maua lo outou faaeaga; ina ia outou i ai foi i le mea Ou te i ai.

verses.en: This is eternal lives—to know the only wise and true God, and Jesus Christ, whom he hath sent. I am he. Receive ye, therefore, my law.
verses.sm: O ola nei e faavavau— o le iloa lea o le Atua poto ma moni e toatasi, ma Iesu Keriso, o lē na auina mai e ia. O A’u o ia. O lea, ia outou talia la’u tulafono.

verses.en: Broad is the gate, and wide the way that leadeth to the deaths; and many there are that go in thereat, because they receive me not, neither do they abide in my law.
verses.sm: E vatele le faitotoa, ma lautele le ala e tau i le oti; ma e toatele o i ai e o atu iina, ona ua latou lē talia a’u, pe ua latou ola i la’u tulafono.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, if a man marry a wife according to my word, and they are sealed by the Holy Spirit of promise, according to mine appointment, and he or she shall commit any sin or transgression of the new and everlasting covenant whatever, and all manner of blasphemies, and if they commit no murder wherein they shed innocent blood, yet they shall come forth in the first resurrection, and enter into their exaltation; but they shall be destroyed in the flesh, and shall be delivered unto the buffetings of Satan unto the day of redemption, saith the Lord God.
verses.sm: E moni, e moni, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, afai e faaipoipo e se tane se avā e tusa ma la’u upu, ma ua faamauina i laua e le Agaga Paia o le folafolaga, e tusa ma la’u tofiga, ma faia e le tane po o le avā soo se agasala lava po o se solitulafono e faasaga i le feagaiga fou ma tumau e faavavau, ma ituaiga uma o upuleaga, ma afai la te lē faia se fasioti tagata la te faamasaa ai le toto lē sala, o le a la tutulai mai lava i le uluai toetutu, ma ulu atu i lo laua faaeaga; ae o le a faaumatia i laua i la le tino, ma o le a tuu atu i laua i tu’iga a Satani seia oo i le aso o le togiolaina, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii le Atua.

verses.en: The blasphemy against the Holy Ghost, which shall not be forgiven in the world nor out of the world, is in that ye commit murder wherein ye shed innocent blood, and assent unto my death, after ye have received my new and everlasting covenant, saith the Lord God; and he that abideth not this law can in nowise enter into my glory, but shall be damned, saith the Lord.
verses.sm: O le upuleaga e faasaga i le Agaga Paia, lea e lē faamagaloina i le lalolagi po o i fafo o le lalolagi, o lo outou faia lea o le fasioti tagata tou te faamasaa ai le toto lē sala, ma outou ioe ai i lo’u oti, ina ua uma ona outou talia o la’u feagaiga fou ma tumau e faavavau, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii le Atua; ma o ia o lē e lē ola i lenei tulafono e leai se ala e mafai ona ulu mai ai i lo’u mamalu, ae o le a tausalaina, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii.

verses.en: I am the Lord thy God, and will give unto thee the law of my Holy Priesthood, as was ordained by me and my Father before the world was.
verses.sm: O A’u o le Alii lou Atua, ma o le a Ou tuu atu ia te oe le tulafono o la’u Perisitua Paia, e pei ona faauuina e A’u ma lo’u Tamā a’o lei i ai le lalolagi.

verses.en: Abraham received all things, whatsoever he received, by revelation and commandment, by my word, saith the Lord, and hath entered into his exaltation and sitteth upon his throne.
verses.sm: Na maua e Aperaamo mea uma, soo se mea lava na maua e ia, e ala i le faaaliga ma le poloaiga, i la’u upu, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii, ma ua ulu atu i lona faaeaga ma ua nofo i luga o lona nofoalii.

verses.en: Abraham received promises concerning his seed, and of the fruit of his loins—from whose loins ye are, namely, my servant Joseph—which were to continue so long as they were in the world; and as touching Abraham and his seed, out of the world they should continue; both in the world and out of the world should they continue as innumerable as the stars; or, if ye were to count the sand upon the seashore ye could not number them.
verses.sm: Na maua e Aperaamo folafolaga e faatatau i ana fanau, ma e faatatau i le fua o ona sulugatiti— o lē o ona sulugatiti ua e sau ai, o lona uiga, o la’u auauna o Iosefa— ia sa faamoemoe ia faaauau pea i le umi latou te i ai i le lalolagi; ma e faatatau ia Aperaamo ma ana fanau, o le a faaauau pea ia te i latou i fafo o le lalolagi; o le a faaauau pea i le lalolagi ma i fafo o le lalolagi ona lē mafaitaulia i latou e pei o fetu; pe, afai tou te faitauina le oneone o i luga o le matafaga tou te lē mafai ona faitaulia i latou.

verses.en: This promise is yours also, because ye are of Abraham, and the promise was made unto Abraham; and by this law is the continuation of the works of my Father, wherein he glorifieth himself.
verses.sm: O lenei folafolaga ua a outou foi, aua o outou e tupuga mai ia Aperaamo, ma sa faia le folafolaga ia Aperaamo; ma o lenei tulafono ua i ai le faaauauga o galuega a lo’u Tamā, ia ua faamamaluina ai e ia o ia lava.

verses.en: Go ye, therefore, and do the works of Abraham; enter ye into my law and ye shall be saved.
verses.sm: O lea, ia outou o atu, ma fai galuega a Aperaamo; ia outou ulu mai i la’u tulafono ma o le a faaolaina ai outou.

verses.en: But if ye enter not into my law ye cannot receive the promise of my Father, which he made unto Abraham.
verses.sm: Ae afai tou te lē ulu mai i la’u tulafono e lē mafai ona outou maua le folafolaga a lo’u Tamā, lea na faia e ia ia Aperaamo.

verses.en: God commanded Abraham, and Sarah gave Hagar to Abraham to wife. And why did she do it? Because this was the law; and from Hagar sprang many people. This, therefore, was fulfilling, among other things, the promises.
verses.sm: Sa poloaiina Aperaamo e le Atua, ma sa tuu atu Akara e Sara ia Aperaamo e avea ma ana avā. Ma aisea na fai ai e Sara lena mea? Aua o le tulafono lea; ma sa tutupu mai ia Akara tagata e toatele. O lea, o lenei mea, na faataunuu ai folafolaga, faatasi ma isi mea.

verses.en: Was Abraham, therefore, under condemnation? Verily I say unto you, Nay; for I, the Lord, commanded it.
verses.sm: O lea, sa i ai ea Aperaamo i lalo o le ta’usalaga? E moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, E leai; aua o A’u, o le Alii, na poloaiina.

verses.en: Abraham was commanded to offer his son Isaac; nevertheless, it was written: Thou shalt not kill. Abraham, however, did not refuse, and it was accounted unto him for righteousness.
verses.sm: Sa poloaiina Aperaamo e osi atu lona atalii o Isaako; ae ui i lea, sa tusia: Aua e te fasioti tagata. E ui i lea, sa lē musu Aperaamo, ma sa faitauina lea mea ia te ia mo le amiotonu.

verses.en: Abraham received concubines, and they bore him children; and it was accounted unto him for righteousness, because they were given unto him, and he abode in my law; as Isaac also and Jacob did none other things than that which they were commanded; and because they did none other things than that which they were commanded, they have entered into their exaltation, according to the promises, and sit upon thrones, and are not angels but are gods.
verses.sm: Sa maua e Aperaamo ni palake, ma sa latou fanauina ia te ia ni fanau; ma sa faitauina lea mea ia te ia mo le amiotonu, ona sa tuu atu i latou ia te ia, ma sa ola o ia i la’u tulafono; e pei foi ona sa lei faia e Isaako ma Iakopo ni isi lava mea nai lo mea na poloaiina ai i laua; ma ona sa laua lē faia ni isi lava mea nai lo mea na poloaiina ai i laua, ua ulu atu i laua i a laua faaeaga, e tusa ma folafolaga, ma ua nonofo i luga o nofoalii, ma ua lē o ni agelu ae o ni atua.

verses.en: David also received many wives and concubines, and also Solomon and Moses my servants, as also many others of my servants, from the beginning of creation until this time; and in nothing did they sin save in those things which they received not of me.
verses.sm: Sa maua foi e Tavita avā e toatele ma palake, ma a’u auauna foi o Solomona ma Mose, e pei foi o le toatele o isi o a’u auauna, mai le amataga o le foafoaga e oo mai i le taimi nei; ma e leai se mea sa latou agasala ai vagana ai i mea na sa latou lē maua mai ia te a’u.

verses.en: David's wives and concubines were given unto him of me, by the hand of Nathan, my servant, and others of the prophets who had the keys of this power; and in none of these things did he sin against me save in the case of Uriah and his wife; and, therefore he hath fallen from his exaltation, and received his portion; and he shall not inherit them out of the world, for I gave them unto another, saith the Lord.
verses.sm: O avā ma palake a Tavita sa tuu atu ia te ia e a’u, i le lima o Natano, la’u auauna, ma isi o perofeta o e na i ai ki o lenei mana; ma sa leai se tasi o ia mea na agasala ai o ia faasaga mai ia te a’u vagana i le tulaga e uiga ia Uria ma lana avā; ma, o lea ua pa’ū ai o ia mai lona faaeaga, ma maua lana vaega; ma o le a lē fai mona tofi i latou i fafo o le lalolagi, ona ua Ou tuuina atu i latou i se isi, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii.

verses.en: I am the Lord thy God, and I gave unto thee, my servant Joseph, an appointment, and restore all things. Ask what ye will, and it shall be given unto you according to my word.
verses.sm: O A’u o le Alii lou Atua, ma ua Ou tuu atu ia te oe, la’u auauna, Iosefa, se tofiga, ma toefuatai mea uma. Ole mai i mea e te manao i ai, ma o le a tuu atu ia te oe e tusa ma la’u upu.

verses.en: And as ye have asked concerning adultery, verily, verily, I say unto you, if a man receiveth a wife in the new and everlasting covenant, and if she be with another man, and I have not appointed unto her by the holy anointing, she hath committed adultery and shall be destroyed.
verses.sm: Ma ona ua e ole mai e uiga i le mulilua, e moni, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te oe, afai e talia e se tane se avā i le feagaiga fou ma tumau e faavavau, ma afai e faatasi le tamaitai ma se isi alii, ma Ou te lei tofiaina ia te ia e ala i le faauuga paia, ua faia e le tamaitai le mulilua ma o le a faaumatia.

verses.en: If she be not in the new and everlasting covenant, and she be with another man, she has committed adultery.
verses.sm: Afai ua lē i ai le tamaitai i le feagaiga fou ma le tumau e faavavau, ma ua faatasi o ia ma se isi alii, ua faia e le tamaitai le mulilua.

verses.en: And if her husband be with another woman, and he was under a vow, he hath broken his vow and hath committed adultery.
verses.sm: Ma afai e faatasi lana tane ma se isi fafine, ma ua i ai le tane i lalo o se folafolaga, ua soli e le tane lana folafolaga ma ua faia e ia le mulilua.

verses.en: And if she hath not committed adultery, but is innocent and hath not broken her vow, and she knoweth it, and I reveal it unto you, my servant Joseph, then shall you have power, by the power of my Holy Priesthood, to take her and give her unto him that hath not committed adultery but hath been faithful; for he shall be made ruler over many.
verses.sm: Ma afai e lei faia e le tamaitai le mulilua, ae ua mamā ma e lei solia e ia lana folafolaga, ma ua iloa e ia lena mea, ma Ou faaali atu ia te oe, o la’u auauna o Iosefa, lena mea, ona i ai lea ia te oe le mana, e ala i le mana o la’u Perisitua Paia, e ave ai o ia ma tuu atu o ia i le tane e lei mulilua ae ua faamaoni; ona o le a fai lea tane ma pule i mea e tele.

verses.en: For I have conferred upon you the keys and power of the priesthood, wherein I restore all things, and make known unto you all things in due time.
verses.sm: Aua ua Ou faaee i luga o oe ki ma le mana o le perisitua, lea ua Ou toefuatai ai mea uma, ma faailoa atu ai ia te oe mea uma i le taimi e tatau ai.

verses.en: And verily, verily, I say unto you, that whatsoever you seal on earth shall be sealed in heaven; and whatsoever you bind on earth, in my name and by my word, saith the Lord, it shall be eternally bound in the heavens; and whosesoever sins you remit on earth shall be remitted eternally in the heavens; and whosesoever sins you retain on earth shall be retained in heaven.
verses.sm: Ma e moni, e moni, Ou te fai atu ia te oe, o soo se mea e te faamaufaailogaina i le lalolagi o le a faamaufaailogaina i le lagi; ma o soo se mea e te faamauina i le lalolagi, i lo’u igoa ma i la’u upu, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii, o le a faamauina e faavavau i le lagi; ma o soo se agasala a soo se tasi e te faamagaloina i le lalolagi o le a faamagaloina foi e faavavau i le lagi; ma o soo se agasala a soo se tasi e te taofia pea i le lalolagi o le a taofia pea foi i le lagi.

verses.en: And again, verily I say, whomsoever you bless I will bless, and whomsoever you curse I will curse, saith the Lord; for I, the Lord, am thy God.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni Ou te fai atu, o soo se tasi e te faamanuiaina o le a Ou faamanuiaina foi, ma o soo se tasi e te fetuuina o le a Ou fetuuina, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii; aua o A’u, o le Alii, o lou Atua.

verses.en: And again, verily I say unto you, my servant Joseph, that whatsoever you give on earth, and to whomsoever you give any one on earth, by my word and according to my law, it shall be visited with blessings and not cursings, and with my power, saith the Lord, and shall be without condemnation on earth and in heaven.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te oe, la’u auauna Iosefa, soo se mea e te foai atu i le lalolagi, ma o soo se tasi e te foai atu i ai, soo se isi lava i luga o le lalolagi, e ala i la’u upu ma tusa ai ma la’u tulafono, o le a asia i faamanuiaga ae lē o fetuu, ma faatasi ma lo’u mana, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii, ma o le a aunoa ma le tausalaga i le lalolagi ma i le lagi.

verses.en: For I am the Lord thy God, and will be with thee even unto the end of the world, and through all eternity; for verily I seal upon you your exaltation, and prepare a throne for you in the kingdom of my Father, with Abraham your father.
verses.sm: Aua o A’u o le Alii lou Atua, ma o le a faatasi ma oe e oo lava i le gataaga o le lalolagi, ma i le faavavau atoa; aua e moni Ou te faamauina i luga o oe lou faaeaga, ma saunia se nofoalii mo oe i le malo o lo’u Tama, faatasi ma Aperaamo lou tamā.

verses.en: Behold, I have seen your sacrifices, and will forgive all your sins; I have seen your sacrifices in obedience to that which I have told you. Go, therefore, and I make a way for your escape, as I accepted the offering of Abraham of his son Isaac.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua Ou vaai i au taulaga, ma o le a faamagaloina au agasala uma; ua Ou vaai i au taulaga i le usiusitai i mea na Ou ta’u atu ia te oe. O lea, inā alu ia, ma Ou te saunia se ala mo lou sao atu, e pei ona Ou taliaina le taulaga a Aperaamo i lona atalii o Isaako.

verses.en: Verily, I say unto you: A commandment I give unto mine handmaid, Emma Smith, your wife, whom I have given unto you, that she stay herself and partake not of that which I commanded you to offer unto her; for I did it, saith the Lord, to prove you all, as I did Abraham, and that I might require an offering at your hand, by covenant and sacrifice.
verses.sm: E moni, Ou te fai atu ia te oe: Ou te tuu atu se poloaiga i la’u auauna tamaitai o Emma Samita, lau avā, o lē na Ou tuu atu ia te oe, ia taofi e ia o ia lava ma ia lē auai i le mea na Ou poloaiina oe e tuu atu ia te ia; aua sa Ou faia lena mea, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii, e tofotofo ai oulua uma, e pei ona sa Ou faia ia Aperaamo, ma ina ia mafai ona Ou tapaina ai se taulaga-mu mai o oulua lima i se feagaiga ma se taulaga-osi.

verses.en: And let mine handmaid, Emma Smith, receive all those that have been given unto my servant Joseph, and who are virtuous and pure before me; and those who are not pure, and have said they were pure, shall be destroyed, saith the Lord God.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu i la’u auauna tamaitai, o Emma Samita, ia talia i latou uma o e ua tuu atu i la’u auauna o Iosefa, ma o e ua amiomamā ma mamā i o’u luma; ma o e ua lē mamā, ae ua fai mai ua mamā i latou, o le a faaumatia, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii le Atua.

verses.en: For I am the Lord thy God, and ye shall obey my voice; and I give unto my servant Joseph that he shall be made ruler over many things; for he hath been faithful over a few things, and from henceforth I will strengthen him.
verses.sm: Aua o A’u o le Alii lou Atua, ma ia outou usiusitai mai i lo’u leo; ma Ou te tuu atu i la’u auauna o Iosefa ia faia o ia ma pule i mea e tele; ona ua faamaoni o ia i luga o mea itiiti; ma o le a Ou faamalosia o ia mai le taimi nei ma le agai i luma.

verses.en: And I command mine handmaid, Emma Smith, to abide and cleave unto my servant Joseph, and to none else. But if she will not abide this commandment she shall be destroyed, saith the Lord; for I am the Lord thy God, and will destroy her if she abide not in my law.
verses.sm: Ma Ou te poloai atu i la’u auauna tamaitai, o Emma Samita, ia nofo ma pipii atu i la’u auauna o Iosefa, ae lē i se isi lava. Ae afai e lē ola o ia i lenei poloaiga o le a faaumatiaina o ia, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii; aua o A’u o le Alii lou Atua, ma o le a faaumatiaina o ia pe afai e lē ola o ia i la’u tulafono.

verses.en: But if she will not abide this commandment, then shall my servant Joseph do all things for her, even as he hath said; and I will bless him and multiply him and give unto him an hundred-fold in this world, of fathers and mothers, brothers and sisters, houses and lands, wives and children, and crowns of eternal lives in the eternal worlds.
verses.sm: Ae afai e lē ola o ia i lenei poloaiga, ona faia lea e la’u auauna o Iosefa o mea uma mo ia, e pei lava ona fai mai o ia; ma o le a Ou faamanuiaina o ia ma faateleina o ia ma tuu atu ia te ia taisautua-selau i lenei lalolagi, o tamā ma tinā, o uso ma tuafafine, o fale ma laueleele, o avā ma fanau, ma palealii o ola e faavavau i lalolagi e faavavau.

verses.en: And again, verily I say, let mine handmaid forgive my servant Joseph his trespasses; and then shall she be forgiven her trespasses, wherein she has trespassed against me; and I, the Lord thy God, will bless her, and multiply her, and make her heart to rejoice.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni Ou te fai atu, ia tuu atu i la’u auauna-tamaitai ia faamagalo atu i la’u auauna o Iosefa i ana solitulafono; ona faamagaloina ai lea o ia i ana solitulafono, ia sa solitulafono ai o ia faasaga mai ia te a’u; ma o A’u o le Alii lou Atua, o le a faamanuiaina o ia, ma faateleina o ia, ma faia ia olioli lona loto.

verses.en: And again, I say, let not my servant Joseph put his property out of his hands, lest an enemy come and destroy him; for Satan seeketh to destroy; for I am the Lord thy God, and he is my servant; and behold, and lo, I am with him, as I was with Abraham, thy father, even unto his exaltation and glory.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, Ou te fai atu, ia lē tuu atu i la’u auauna o Iosefa e tuu ese atu ana meatotino mai ona lima, ne’i sau se fili ma faaumatia o ia; aua ua saili Satani e faaumatia; aua o A’u o le Alii lou Atua, ma o ia o la’u auauna; ma faauta, ma taga’i, ua Ou faatasi ma ia, e pei ona sa Ou i ai ia Aperaamo, lou tamā, e oo lava i lona faaeaga ma lona mamalu.

verses.en: Now, as touching the law of the priesthood, there are many things pertaining thereunto.
verses.sm: O lenei, e faatatau i le tulafono o le perisitua, e tele mea e faatatau i ai.

verses.en: Verily, if a man be called of my Father, as was Aaron, by mine own voice, and by the voice of him that sent me, and I have endowed him with the keys of the power of this priesthood, if he do anything in my name, and according to my law and by my word, he will not commit sin, and I will justify him.
verses.sm: E moni, afai e valaaulia se tagata e lo’u Tamā, e pei o Arona, i lo’u lava leo, ma ala i le leo o ia o lē na auina mai a’u, ma ua Ou faaeeina o ia i ki o le mana o lenei perisitua, afai e fai e ia se mea i lo’u igoa, ma e tusa ai ma la’u tulafono ma i la’u upu, ma o le a lē faia e ia se agasala, o le a Ou ta’uamiotonuina o ia.

verses.en: Let no one, therefore, set on my servant Joseph; for I will justify him; for he shall do the sacrifice which I require at his hands for his transgressions, saith the Lord your God.
verses.sm: O lea, ia lē tuu atu i se tasi, e faitio i la’u auauna o Iosefa; aua o le a Ou tauamiotonuina o ia; ona o le a faia e ia le taulaga ua Ou tapaina mai i ona lima mo ana solitulafono, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii lo outou Atua.

verses.en: And again, as pertaining to the law of the priesthood—if any man espouse a virgin, and desire to espouse another, and the first give her consent, and if he espouse the second, and they are virgins, and have vowed to no other man, then is he justified; he cannot commit adultery for they are given unto him; for he cannot commit adultery with that that belongeth unto him and to no one else.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e faatatau i le tulafono o le perisitua— afai e faaipoipo e soo se alii se taupou, ma ua manao e faaipoipo i se isi foi, ma tuu mai e lē na muamua lana faatagaga, ma afai e faaipoipo le alii i le avā lona lua, ma o i laua uma o ni taupou, ma e lei folafola atu i se isi lava alii, ona tauamiotonuina lea o lea alii; e lē mafai ona mulilua lenei alii ona ua tuuina atu i laua ia te ia; ona e lē mafai ona mulilua o ia ma lē ua ā ia ae lē a se isi lava.

verses.en: And if he have ten virgins given unto him by this law, he cannot commit adultery, for they belong to him, and they are given unto him; therefore is he justified.
verses.sm: Ma afai e tuu atu ia te ia ni taupou e toasefulu i lenei tulafono, e lē mafai ona mulilua ai o ia, ona ua ā ia i latou, ma ua tuuina atu i latou ia te ia; o lea ua tauamiotonuina ai o ia.

verses.en: But if one or either of the ten virgins, after she is espoused, shall be with another man, she has committed adultery, and shall be destroyed; for they are given unto him to multiply and replenish the earth, according to my commandment, and to fulfil the promise which was given by my Father before the foundation of the world, and for their exaltation in the eternal worlds, that they may bear the souls of men; for herein is the work of my Father continued, that he may be glorified.
verses.sm: Ae afai e faatasi se tasi po o se isi o taupou e toasefulu ma se isi alii ina ua uma ona faaipoipoina o ia, ua faia e lea taupou le mulilua, ma o le a faaumatia o ia; ona ua tuu atu i latou ia te ia e faateleina ma faatumuina le lalolagi, e tusa ma la’u poloaiga, ma faataunuu le folafolaga na tuuina mai e lo’u Tamā a o le i faavaeina le lalolagi, ma mo lo latou faaeaga i lalolagi e faavavau, ina ia latou fanauina agaga o tagata; ona o totonu o lenei mea e faaauau ai pea le galuega a lo’u Tamā, ina ia faamamaluina o ia.

verses.en: And again, verily, verily, I say unto you, if any man have a wife, who holds the keys of this power, and he teaches unto her the law of my priesthood, as pertaining to these things, then shall she believe and administer unto him, or she shall be destroyed, saith the Lord your God; for I will destroy her; for I will magnify my name upon all those who receive and abide in my law.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni, e moni, Ou te fai atu ia te outou, afai e i ai se avā i se alii, o lē ua umia ki o lenei mana, ma aoao atu e ia i lana avā le tulafono o la’u perisitua, e faatatau i ia mea, ia talitonu le avā ma auauna ia te ia, po o le a faaumatia o ia, ua fetalai mai ai le Alii lo outou Atua; ona o le a Ou faaumatia o ia; aua o le a Ou faalauteleina lo’u igoa i luga o i latou uma o e talia ma ola i la’u tulafono.

verses.en: Therefore, it shall be lawful in me, if she receive not this law, for him to receive all things whatsoever I, the Lord his God, will give unto him, because she did not believe and administer unto him according to my word; and she then becomes the transgressor; and he is exempt from the law of Sarah, who administered unto Abraham according to the law when I commanded Abraham to take Hagar to wife.
verses.sm: O lea, o le a tusa ai ma le tulafono ia te a’u, pe afai e lē talia e le fafine lenei tulafono, le mauaina e le tane o soo se mea o mea uma e tuu atu e A’u, o le Alii lona Atua, ia te ia, ona sa lē talitonu le fafine ma auauna atu i le tane e tusa ai ma la’u upu; ma ona avea ai lea o le fafine ma solitulafono; ma tatala ai le tane mai le tulafono a Sara, o lē sa auauna atu ia Aperaamo e tusa ai ma le tulafono i le taimi ina ua Ou poloaiina Aperaamo e ave Akara e fai ma ana avā.

verses.en: And now, as pertaining to this law, verily, verily, I say unto you, I will reveal more unto you, hereafter; therefore, let this suffice for the present. Behold, I am Alpha and Omega. Amen.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, e faatatau i lenei tulafono, e moni, e moni, Ou te fai atu ia te oe, o le a Ou faaali atu ni isi mea e tele ia te oe, i se taimi o mulimuli mai; o lea, ia lava ai lea mo le taimi nei. Faauta, o A’u o le Alefa ma le Omeka. Amene.
